evidence_quotes.O: I did a lot of research before choosing the Meade CaptureView 8x42 2MP Digital Camera Binocular. This one offers the most for a reasonable price.
evidence_quotes.C: I've been using a UPS to protect my equipment for years, and I can't recommend this practice enough.
evidence_quotes.E: I am extremely happy with my Passport Max, having stepped up from a Passport 8500.
evidence_quotes.A: if you are a Mac User you should be aware that there are some compatibility issues that may be a serious show-stopper for you.
evidence_quotes.N: The problem is that I hate fiddling with the batteries--the hassle of tracking them down online, price-shopping, and then shutting everything down and taking the thing apart.
